root_cause: After pdf_create, Qwen auto-compact ran because turn-2 prompt_tokens 14447 exceeded the 0.85*16384=13926 threshold. Compact is a side query with tool_count=0, max_tokens≈10048, stream=true, reasoning_effort=none. Ollama returned 2713 completion tokens as normal delta.content (<analysis>+<state_snapshot>), not reasoning_content. ACP strips analysis and does not emit agent_message_chunk. Post-compact orphan-tool repair injected 'Tool execution result was not recorded' for the successful pdf_create, so the model called pdf_create again.

questions.3_parser_drops_pre_tool: no — compact has no tool_calls; analysis is stripped by design of chatCompressionService
questions.4_serve_buffers_without_acp: yes — compact output is not agent_message_chunk / thoughts=0
questions.5_long_abschlussbericht: no — it is the compact summarizer XML, not a user-facing report
questions.6_broken_tool_call: no during compact; after compact orphan repair fakes pdf_create failure → retry
questions.8_direct_replay: yes — same /v1 path through proxy; compact-head replay also emits content not reasoning
questions.9_fast_same_request: no compact on FAST 32k; 3-tool 47s, no duplicate
questions.10_other_tools: triggers when prompt ≥ auto threshold (after large memory_load + system 27k + 13 tools). pdf_create is the first tool after that. 6-tool still had a short FAST compact after pdf_render (n_gen=1412, VRAM 8GB), no duplicate.
